name: Central Provident Fund Board

scam_info.sample: Calls will only be made from 6227 1188 . CPF Board will never call with WhatsApp. ... SMS messages are always from “ gov.sg ”. ... Emails will always end with @cpf.gov.sg or @e.cpf.gov.sg .
scam_info.notes: Main anti-scam hub ('Safeguard your savings with CPF anti-scam measures'): sections Overview/Prevention/Scam advisory/Report a scam/Resources/FAQs/Articles. Anti-scam brochure PDFs in EN/ZH/MS/TA.
